title: Proposal Offered Webhook
description: Account-anchored invalidation fired when a seller creates a committed offer against an accepted media buy, after the snapshot is readable through list_proposals. A sibling of proposal-created-webhook.json with the same identifiers-only rule: the payload names the offer and its response deadline but carries no commercial terms or seller prose, so it cannot inject terms or instructions into a buyer agent. Experimental in AdCP 3.3 (media_buy.seller_offers). Registered through sync_accounts notification_configs with event_types: ["proposal.offered"]. Receivers verify the webhook signature, dedupe by idempotency_key, and call list_proposals on the seller bound to the notification config, never on an endpoint taken from the body. Push is optional; list_proposals remains the authoritative read. notification_id equals proposal_id, so a seller MUST mint offer proposal_id values that match the notification_id pattern. A replacement offer is a new proposal with a new proposal_id.

idempotency_key.description: Random fire identifier reused across retries. Receivers dedupe within the authenticated sender scope.

notification_id.description: Logical notification identifier. Always equals proposal_id; re-emissions of the same offer retain it.

proposal_id.description: The offer's proposal_id. notification_id equals it.

expires_at.description: Response deadline: the offer's expires_at. The seller holds any replacement inventory until then; at this instant the offer lapses and the signed terms stand.

offer_reason.description: Why the seller made this offer. One of installment_postponed, installment_cancelled, preemption, under_delivery, or seller_request.

examples.description: A creator postponed a scheduled installment and the seller offered a new date
